No columns/baseline escrow resolution, global Frame semantic index, source reevaluation or second solver.
gates: Owner-first audits and meaningful independent RED/GREEN; modified manifest narrower than finite inspected domains.
Typed child edges/source packets, preserved original snapshots/parents; future Content/edge requires decision.

Shared arena reserve-only aliases, immutable capture authority and Session rebind.
